title: [agent-usage 08/12] Attribute gateway calls to the Semp message they answer
body:
**Blocked by:** #1727
**Model tier:** high

## Context

Model tier rationale: It adds a new header contract across the agents and gateway processes, a tenant-scoped reference that must not reveal foreign ids, and a schema migration on a table that every AI call writes.

A chat conversation with Semp runs as one long agent session that answers many messages. Every model call of that session is recorded in `ai_gateway_calls` with the same `agent_run_id`, so today the cost of one answer cannot be told apart from the cost of another. The agent session sends the run id to the AI gateway in the header `x-semprec-agent-run-id`; that header is set once per session in `backend/services/semprec-agents/src/agentSessionComposition.ts` (a wrapper around `gateway.streamFn`), and `backend/services/semprec-ai-gateway/src/piMessagesHandler.ts` validates it as a UUID (`extractAgentRunId`) and passes it to `complete()` in `backend/packages/ai-gateway/src/gateway.ts`, whose `reserve()` calls `reserveGatewayCall` in `backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiGatewayCallsStore.ts`. That insert only succeeds when the tenant is active and any referenced run is visible; otherwise it throws `attribution_refused`, identically for a foreign and an unknown id.

This issue records, on each gateway call, which Semp message the call was made to answer. The Semp message tables come from #1367 and the job that processes one queued message in `semprec-agents` comes from #1727; this issue passes the id of the message being processed from that job to the gateway. Later issues read the column: #1860 (the typed summary stored on each reply, with its token count), #1889 (usage scoped to one answer) and #1932 (answers listed as separate rows). The cost of a heartbeat tick is not attributed per message: a tick's message is created only after the run, and its cost is the cost of the whole run by `agent_run_id`.

Decision: one reply's cost is the sum of the gateway calls tagged with its message id, never a time-window guess over the session's calls. The header is set per turn, not per session, because a session serves many messages.

## Task

Load `db-migrations`, `ai-gateway`, `canonical-keys` and `testing`.

1. Add the migration `backend/packages/data/src/db/migrations/NNNN_ai_gateway_calls_semp_message_id.sql (next free ordinal at commit time)`: add `ai_gateway_calls.semp_message_id uuid NULL`; add a tenant-composite foreign key `(tenant_id, semp_message_id)` to `semp_messages (tenant_id, id)` following the pattern of migration `0083_tenant_composite_foreign_keys.sql` (NOT VALID then VALIDATE in the same migration is acceptable because every existing row is NULL); add the index `ai_gateway_calls_tenant_semp_message_idx ON ai_gateway_calls (tenant_id, semp_message_id)`. The semp_messages table and its `(tenant_id, id)` unique key are delivered by #1367; if the key is not there, stop and say so in the pull request instead of altering that table here.
2. In `aiGatewayCallsStore.ts`, add `sempMessageId` to `ReserveGatewayCallInput`, the `AiGatewayCallDbRow`, `mapRow` and `AiGatewayCallRow`, and to the `RETURNING` lists. In `reserveGatewayCall` the insert gets the extra predicate `($n::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM semp_messages WHERE id = $n::uuid))`, so a foreign and an unknown message id are refused with the same `attribution_refused` and no row, exactly like `agentRunId` and `projectItemId`. Only the reserve path takes the id; the other record functions are unchanged.
3. In `backend/packages/ai-gateway/src/types.ts` add the optional `sempMessageId` to `GatewayCallContext`, and pass it through `reserve()` in `gateway.ts`.
4. In `piMessagesHandler.ts`, add `SEMP_MESSAGE_ID_HEADER = "x-semprec-semp-message-id"`, read and validate it the way `extractAgentRunId` does (absent means null; present but not a UUID is a 400 `ValidationError` with that field name) and pass it to `complete()`.
5. In `agentSessionComposition.ts`, make the `streamFn` wrapper add the header per call, not per session: the composition keeps a settable "current Semp message id" that the Semp turn runner from #1727 sets before it prompts the session with a queued message and clears when the turn ends (also on failure). When the value is unset (heartbeat ticks, MCP and delegated runs) the header is omitted, and the existing `x-semprec-agent-run-id` header is unchanged.
6. Tests: a gateway test that a call made with the header stores the message id and without it stores NULL; a test that a foreign tenant's message id and an unknown id give the identical `attribution_refused` with no row; a unit test of the wrapper (header present only while a message id is set, and removed after the turn, including after a thrown error); a case in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/tenantForeignKeys.test.ts` for the new foreign key (a row of tenant B naming tenant A's message fails with 23503 like a random UUID).

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/db/migrations/NNNN_ai_gateway_calls_semp_message_id.sql (next free ordinal at commit time)
- backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiGatewayCallsStore.ts (reserve input, insert predicate, row mapping)
- backend/packages/ai-gateway/src/types.ts (GatewayCallContext)
- backend/packages/ai-gateway/src/gateway.ts (reserve passthrough)
- backend/services/semprec-ai-gateway/src/piMessagesHandler.ts (header read and validation)
- backend/services/semprec-agents/src/agentSessionComposition.ts (per-turn header)
- the Semp turn runner file introduced by #1727 (the single call that sets and clears the current message id)
- backend/services/semprec-ai-gateway/src/__tests__/piMessagesHandler.test.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/tenantForeignKeys.test.ts (one case)
- backend/services/semprec-agents/src/__tests__/agentSessionComposition.unit.test.ts (wrapper cases)

## Scope

### In scope

- The nullable column, its tenant foreign key and index, and writing it at reservation from the new header.

### Out of scope

- Reading the column: per-answer usage in #1889, the stored step summary and tokens in #1860, answer rows in #1932.
- Cost of heartbeat tick messages (taken from the whole run by `agent_run_id`).
- Backfilling calls recorded before this change (they stay NULL).
- Any change to `x-semprec-agent-run-id` handling.

## Acceptance criteria

- When two answers are produced in one chat session, then the gateway calls of each carry that answer's message id and none carries the other's.
- When a call is made without the header, then `semp_message_id` is NULL and nothing else changes.
- When the header holds a message id of another tenant or an unknown one, then the call is refused with the same `attribution_refused` response and no `ai_gateway_calls` row is written.
- When the header is not a UUID, then the gateway answers 400.
- The migration applies on a populated database without rewriting rows, and the tenant foreign key rejects a foreign message id with 23503.
